artworks.title: Leaving the Bath (La sortie du bain)
artworks.medium: electric crayon, etching, drypoint, and aquatint
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a room. One person is mostly visible from behind, wearing a long garment that covers them from head to toe, with only their hair partially visible. They are interacting with a large piece of cloth. The second individual is mostly obscured, standing to the right and holding up a sheet or large piece of fabric that partially conceals their body. Only the upper part of their body can be discerned. This individual's head is visible above the cloth, covered with what appears to be a head scarf or cap. The setting appears to be indoors, possibly in a room with patterned flooring. A tall plant is situated to the right side.

artworks.title: Tiger Sleeping in the Desert (Tigre couché dans le désert)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a big cat. The image shows a big cat lying on the ground, its body stretched out and its head resting on its paws. The animal is depicted in black, with lines suggesting the texture of its fur. It is set against a background of a landscape with rolling hills and a textured sky. The details are created using fine lines that give a sense of depth and contrast between the foreground and background.

artworks.title: Sortie du bain
artworks.description: The image contains various curved and linear shapes creating an interplay of light and shadow. It has an abstract quality, with forms resembling human silhouettes. In the foreground, two figures are present, one seated and the other standing in a distorted manner. The background includes geometric shapes that suggest a room with a chair. The piece has a grainy, textured appearance.

artworks.title: The Laundresses (Les blanchisseuses (La repassage))
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene with soft, impressionistic lines depicting several indistinct figures engaged in indoor activities. The image captures a domestic setting, with a focus on dynamic lighting and shadow play. A figure is shown resting in the foreground, while another is involved in a task. The abstracted lines suggest movement and the textures evoke a sense of quiet, everyday life. This is in the style of Edgar Degas, known for his emphasis on human figures in personal, unposed moments and his exploration of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Bouddha (Buddha)
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown-black on japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sculpture of a seated figure in a meditative pose, resembling Buddha. The figure is intricately carved with detailed features and a calm expression. Above the figure is an ornate arch or halo-like structure. The sculpture appears in black and white, giving it an antique look. To the left of the figure are the letters "PG" and the number "10". The background is softly hued.

artworks.title: The Ox Cart (Le char a boeufs)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a person walking alongside an ox. The scene features a simplistic and rough texture achieved through a printmaking technique. A figure with a wide-brimmed hat leads the ox, carrying a load. In the background, there are trees or structures on the horizon and hills or mountains further away. The image is monochromatic with shades of black and white, creating a contrast between dark and light elements.

artworks.title: Dramas of the Sea: A Descent into the Maelstrom (Les drames de la mer: une descente dans le maelstrom)
artworks.description: The image shows swirling curved lines that resemble ocean waves. A boat with two figures is at the top center. In the lower right corner, a shape suggests a face or a human figure holding onto a boat's edge. The lines create a dramatic scene of sea and sky, depicting the power and chaos of the ocean.

artworks.title: The Rape of Europa (L'enlevement d'Europe)
artworks.medium: woodcut on chine collé, with a fragment of another print on back of mount
artworks.description: This is a painting of two figures on a horse with abstract and animal motifs in the background. The image captures an imaginative scene where two elongated, stylized figures are riding a horse, with a large bird depicted in a separate section of the image. The horse stands at the center of the composition, and the expressions and postures of the figures suggest a journey or movement. The background suggests abstract forms resembling clouds and celestial elements. The artwork employs a monochrome palette, emphasized by the use of bold outlines and shadows.

artworks.title: Women, Animals and Foliage (Femmes, animaux et feuillages)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene with figures and nature elements. The composition includes a standing figure, a pair of birds, two seated figures, and foliage. A standalone figure is visible to the side. Circular shapes with inscriptions or designs are on the ground. The woodcut features bold lines and minimal detailing, executed in the style of Paul Gauguin. The piece merges symbolic and abstract forms with elements of the natural world. The overall aesthetic is primitive and sophisticated, with a focus on form and silhouette.

artworks.title: Woman Picking Fruit and the Savage (Femme cueillant des fruits et oviri)
artworks.description: The image displays an array of intertwining shapes and lines that divide the composition into two sections filled with abstract figures and patterns. The left side features curving lines and human-like forms in a vertical stance, resembling figures with elongated arms and heads. On the right, a prominent face with exaggerated features and an open mouth connects to other unclear forms, possibly reminiscent of a totem or mask from cultural artifacts. The artwork uses shadows and linear detailing, echoing elements of human forms while remaining ambiguous and open to interpretation.

artworks.title: Stéphane Mallarmé
artworks.medium: etching printed in brown on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile, with thick mustache and short, neatly combed hair. His features include piercing eyes, a prominent nose, and a distinguished moustache. He is wearing a collared jacket. A crow is illustrated on the right side, slightly overlapping his head. The background features patterned, textured shading. The overall style is sketch-like, with subtle details in fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Plate with the Head of a Horned Devil (Planche au diable cornu)
artworks.medium: woodcut on very thin japan paper
artworks.description: The image consists of swirling lines and curved shapes creating an abstract composition. Dark shapes resemble the silhouette of an animal with horn and eyes. Nearby, a bird-like form with a curved beak appears perched. Abstracted human forms are seen on the right, one figure with a flowing mane. Leaves and curling lines are interspersed throughout, suggesting a natural setting.

artworks.title: Be in Love and You will be Happy (Soyez amoureuses, vous serez heureuses)
artworks.medium: woodcut in light brown and black on chine collé
artworks.description: This print shows an array of abstract shapes and lines on a textured background. Many forms resemble human figures, although many of their features are abstracted or exaggerated. One figure near the center has a skull-like face and is seated and with their head in their hands, looking out at us. Other shapes include a child seated on the ground on the left and a figure with long hair and wide eyes on the right, their hands clasped in prayer. In the upper half of the print, there is text in a swirling ribbon, as well as more stylized human faces, most depicted from the shoulders up. The background is filled with solid and patterned sections in shades of black, reddish-brown, and beige.

artworks.title: Te Faruru (They are Making Love Here)
artworks.description: The image portrays a person seated in a crouched position, embracing an infant. The person's head is slightly bowed, with eyes closed. The individual's hair falls to the right side, and they wear minimal clothing with a red fabric around their waist. The background is textured with lines indicating movement or wind. In the upper right corner, there are inscriptions and a plant-like design. The color scheme consists of warm earthy tones.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Le Sourire" (Titre du Sourire)
artworks.description: The image features a collection of abstract shapes and lines that form a variety of figures. Wavy and curvilinear lines create a central form resembling an animal with an elongated neck and legs. To the left, abstract forms and textures suggest birds with curved beaks and rounded bodies. Text is included above these figures. On the right, another abstract bird form is present. The composition evokes an imaginative scene with animals, utilizing dynamic shapes.

artworks.title: The Universe is Created (L'Univers est cree)
artworks.description: The image displays flowing lines and shapes that swirl and stretch across the canvas. The design incorporates a play of colors and forms, possibly resembling elements from nature such as rolling hills, leaves, or mountains merging with abstracted figures. A central shape is reminiscent of a creature's head or a mask with an elongated nose and intricate patterned decoration resembling a ceremonial headdress. The use of earthy colors and swirling lines conveys the fluidity of natural landscapes within a dynamic and abstract representation.

artworks.title: An Arabian Horse
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing beside a horse. The person has one arm over the horse's neck and the other hand holding the horse's halter. The person's facial expression is calm. They are wearing traditional clothing, including loose-fitting trousers and a long top or robe, with a turban on their head. There are no visible accessories or jewelry on the person. The background shows a desert landscape with a tent, seated figures, and palm trees, suggesting a desert camp. The image is in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Groom Mounted on a Carriage-Horse (Cheval de carrosse monte par un palfrenier)
artworks.description: The image shows a man on a horse. The man is sitting upright on the horse, looking to the side. He has a hat, short hair, and is wearing a dark jacket, light trousers, and boots. He holds the reins with both hands. The horse wears a saddle and bridle, with its head turned slightly to the side. The background includes a wall and a textured surface.

artworks.title: The Coal Waggon
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a large coal wagon being pulled by a team of four horses on a dirt road. The wagon, horses, and surroundings are depicted in pencil sketch with detailed textures.

artworks.title: A Party of Life Guards
artworks.description: Two figures in military attire are depicted conversing. On the left, a person on horseback with one arm resting on their thigh, wearing a tall helmet with a plume, a detailed jacket, and boots is shown. The figure has distinct facial features and a firm expression. On the right, another figure stands beside a horse, facing the seated figure, wearing a similar helmet, a cross-body sash, a jacket, and high boots, holding an object resembling a sword. The background features faint sketches of additional horse-mounted figures, blending into a lightly shaded backdrop, suggesting an informal military setting. The image has a monochromatic tone, enhancing its historical and formal appearance.

artworks.title: Grasp All, Lose All (Qui trop embrasse, mal etrient)
artworks.description: The image shows a nude person walking up a slope, carrying large objects like tools and scrolls. They have short, curly hair and visible facial features in profile. Over their right shoulder is a cherubic figure, a small winged child facing the viewer. Around the person's feet lies drapery. The background includes a decorative column, foliage, trees, and a lightly sketched sky.

artworks.title: Four Magistrates of Besançon (Quatre magistrats de Besançon)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of four men seated on ornate chairs. The two men on the outer edges have one leg crossed over the other, while the two in the middle sit facing slightly towards each other. The central figure points with his right hand towards the person on his left. Their facial features include groomed beards and mustaches, and each man wears headwear ranging from crowns to hats with feathers. They wear period-style clothing with robes, tunics, fur elements, and elaborate patterns. Some men wear rings and necklaces. The setting is a luxurious interior with a detailed tapestry backdrop featuring a double-headed eagle emblem above the central figure and Latin text "Plus Ultra" etched into the fabric. The area is draped with curtains, decorated with heraldic shields, and the flooring displays intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Environs de Dieppe
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with large cliffs on the left side and thatched-roof huts at their base. The horizon line is in the upper part of the image, meeting a stormy sky. The ocean below has dynamic patterns, a boat is navigating the rough waters. The color scheme consists of deep, muted tones, creating a moody atmosphere.

artworks.title: Marée Basse
artworks.description: The image shows a ship stranded on a shoreline at low tide. The ship is on a sandy and mud-streaked surface, with its sails down and masts reaching into a cloudy sky. Smaller figures or structures are visible on the distant shoreline, while nautical objects like ropes and crates are scattered around. The precise linework contrasts with the soft clouds above, and the monochromatic color palette adds a somber mood. The overall effect is one of stillness and quietude.
